en: Increases the size of your upgrade grid.
Commandeers 1 column from each of your other upgrade grids.
Enemies you corrode with any weapon have a chance to return ammo to the magazine over time.
Gain infinite ammo. Sustained fire damages you according to this gun's element.
Killing an ignited target causes it to explode.
Electrocuting a target returns ammo to the magazine.
Igniting a target applies a +5 fire to nearby targets.
While constantly shooting, every 15th bullet fired will heal you.
Hold the trigger to build charge. Upon release, all prepared ammo is fired very quickly.
Dealing damage with other gear returns ammo to the magazine. Reload speed is slightly decreased.
Increases potency of the applied element. Horizontal spread is greatly increased.
Fire rate is increased for each bullet that's loaded into the magazine. Base fire rate is decreased.
Electrocuting a target increases move speed for a short time.
Rapidly igniting multiple targets increases the amount of fire per shot.
Sustained damage increases amount of applied acid and damage as well as recoil.
Take reduced damage while charging. Charge time is increased.
Fires slow-moving plasma that deals increased damage.
Fires two bullets at once. Magazine size and fire rate are decreased.
Charges up to release an elemental discharge that damages any nearby targets.
Targets taking damage over time from your ignition, electrocution, or corrosion give you stacks of Power. Hold RELOAD to convert all Power stacks into overflow ammo.
Increases range for each upgrade of a different rarity that's touching this one.
Fire faster in a larger spread.
Fire a four-round burst. The last bullet in each burst is replaced with a tracking missile.
Bullets auto-track to targets while sliding.
Reload speed is briefly increased after killing a target.
Reload speed is increased but magazine size is decreased.
Magazine size is increased, but damage is slightly decreased.
While airborne, firing a shot pushes you backwards. Force increases as mag size decreases.
Applying fire to a target also applies it to you. When you ignite yourself, you gain immolation for 6.5 seconds.
Hold AIM to fire a flamethrower.
Hold RELOAD to charge up bullets. Release to fire all charged bullets in a rapid burst.
Killing a core returns ammo to the magazine.
Move faster while ignited and holding this weapon.
Damage falloff is reset when a bullet bounces.
Bullets pierce through targets instead of bouncing.
Hold RELOAD to charge up an igniting grenade shot.
Bullets gain an extra bounce. Damage increases with each bounce.
Bullets always apply fire to enemy cores.
Adds an extra pellet to each shot. This upgrade can stack.
Extra ammo is added to the magazine when you gain immolation.
Fires 2 shots before reloading. Damage and reload speed are increased. Spread is decreased.
Bullets fire in a tighter spread but deal less damage.
Fire slower, deal more damage, and apply more fire.
Fire faster while you are ignited.
Reload speed is increased, but magazine size is decreased.
Fire faster in a larger spread. Magazine size is greatly increased.
After sliding, your next shot deals increased damage.
Bullets apply more fire but shoot in a much wider spread.
While firing, extra pellets are created from nearby players who have a Swarm Launcher equipped.
Pellets explode but deal less damage.

Hold RELOAD to consume reserve ammo and gain charge for your equipped grenade.
While airborne, you automatically spawn swarm pellets in front of you. Their fire rate increases the longer you're in the air. This can trigger when the Swarm Launcher is not equipped.
Pellets can track to players and heal them.
You can fire while sprinting and sliding.
Hold RELOAD charge up a high powered melee attack. Each consumed pellet increases the size of the hit.
Hold RELOAD to consume reserve ammo and regenerate health.
Reload speed is decreased, but you move much faster while reloading.
Hovering pellets follow your crosshair but travel slower.
Fire all pellets at once. Magazine size is decreased.
Magazine size is increased for each unique upgrade that touches this one.
Pellet damage increases the longer they hover.
Ammo is automatically regenerated over time while the swarm is hovering.
Pellets are more accurate and automatically dive toward targets.
Firing briefly increases your move speed.
Fire slower, high-damage pellets that automatically dive toward targets.
Range and accuracy are increased, but magazine size is decreased.
Fire a shot of 6 pellets. Magazine size and ammo capacity are increased.
Releasing the swarm before your magazine is empty gives you a burst of speed.
Range and spread are both increased.
Electrocuting a target with any weapon increases the Swarm Launcher's reload speed.
Regenerate more Swarm Launcher ammo from dealing damage with your other weapon. Ammo capacity is increased.
Damaging a target with the laser has a chance to arc a shocking bolt of lightning to nearby enemies.

The DMLR automatically switches between DMR and laser modes at the given interval, and the laser has infinite charge. Dealing damage with the DMR increases laser damage and dealing damage with the laser increases DMR damage.
The laser becomes the default mode. Dealing damage with the laser generates ammo for a more powerful DMR mode
Throw used magazines on reload to deal a shock explosion. Shoot the discarded mag to cause a second, larger explosion. Explosion power increases when less ammo is tossed.

Gain laser charge when the given element is fully applied to you.
Killing a target has a chance to refund DMR ammo.
Move faster while firing the laser.
Dealing damage with the laser regenerates bullets in your magazine.
Healing an ally with the laser provides some charge.

DMR mode deals increased damage but fires slower.
You hover while firing the laser.
Killing a core with the laser refunds some charge.
Deal more damage to shells but less damage to limbs.
Dealing damage generates more laser charge, but capacity is reduced.
Deal more damage to limbs but less damage to shells.

Depleting the battery releases an elemental burst.
Every 3rd bullet applies the given element.
Gain more laser charge for dealing damage.
Range and aim zoom are increased.
Laser charge capacity is increased, but DMR ammo capacity is decreased.

Firing your last shot has a chance to refund ammo.

Fire up to 4 plates at once.
Shoot a plate with an element to create an elemental explosion.

Plates create a bee explosion when recalled.
Your movement ability is partially recharged when you electrocute a target with the Plate Launcher.
While standing on one of your plates, gain damage resistance and all of your outgoing damage is increased.

Catching a plate while mid-air boosts you upward.

Fire more plates at a faster rate. Plate size is reduced.
Plates create a shockwave on impact that pushes back enemies.

Plates travel faster and can be fired more often.

Plate damage is greatly increased while returning to the gun and after bouncing.

Plate damage is increased the further they travel.
Damage is increased, but so is spread.

Bullets have a chance to be infused with fire, shock, or acid.

Reload Speed: [+38% - +42%]

Chance: [8.5% - 10%]

Killing a core generates a small amount of reserve ammo for your equipped heavy weapon. This upgrade can stack

Coils apply more of their element to targets.
Hold R to consume your grenade and convert the rest of your magazine into explosive bullets of that grenade's element.
On reload, you warp back in time to a previous position, then gain a small speed boost and create an explosion.

Damage increases based on how fast you're moving. Base damage is decreased.

While you are swarmed by bees, the Accelerator deals increased damage. you move faster, and you fall slower.
